The Problem

With most QSR Voice AI systems, reliability is rare.
And you need your orders well-done.

Typical QSR Voice AI systems can’t consistently deliver above 70-80% order completion, and that’s just not enough to drive ROI at scale.

You start strong in pilots, but the Voice AI’s performance begins slipping the moment you scale.

Your staff regularly needs to step in to fix the AI’s errors, which hurts efficiency and the guest experience.

You realize your team needs more than just tech to improve operational performance at scale.

The Solution

Hi Auto is purpose-built for QSR drive-thrus to deliver reliability at scale.  We achieve over 93% order completion and 96% accuracy across ~1,000 stores.

Give franchisees flexibility, without losing control

Let franchisees adjust menus, LTOs, and regional offers to match local needs. You stay in charge of brand standards and execution across the entire system.

It's hard to imagine there could be technology this effective

The technology pays for itself with the labor hours we were able to take out.

Optimize performance at every drive-thru

Continuously fine-tune scripts, voice, and upsells to improve friendliness, optimize menu time, and grow average ticket size. Push updates quickly and drive better guest experiences across every store in your chain.

Improve labor efficiency and team well-being

Free up staff from stressful multi tasking and order taking interaction for other ROI-generating work. Lower labor costs, reduce stress and turnover, and let your team focus on food and hospitality where it matters most.

That’s the biggest thing I’ve noticed, a reduction in stress levels

Step 1

Step 3

Got Questions? We’ve Got Answers

See All FAQs
What is Hi Auto’s AI Order Taker?

Hi Auto is an AI order taking system for quick service restaurants (QSRs). It automates drive-thru ordering with over 93% completion and 96% accuracy at scale.

How does Hi Auto improve drive-thru operations?

It automates the ordering process, frees up staff to focus on what matters most, improves throughput, reduces errors, and enhances the guest experience.

Who uses Hi Auto’s voice AI system?

Trusted by top QSR brands and over 200 franchisees, Hi Auto is active in ~1,000 stores and completes more than 60 million orders annually.

Why choose Hi Auto over other AI order takers?

Hi Auto is purpose-built for QSR drive-thrus and outperforms competitors with higher accuracy and completion rates at scale. Most voice AI systems can’t consistently deliver beyond 70 to 80 percent completion, which is too low to drive ROI across a chain.

How many drive-thrus are using Hi Auto?

~1,000 stores use Hi Auto, and that number continues to grow.

Is Hi Auto multilingual?

Yes. Hi Auto supports both English and Spanish, enabling smooth and efficient ordering in bilingual markets.

What makes Hi Auto different from other AI voice ordering systems?

It continuously optimizes scripts and upsells, gives franchisees local flexibility, and improves labor efficiency while enhancing team well-being.

How can I see Hi Auto in action?

You can visit one of our customer drive-thrus to experience it firsthand. Then, book a free consultation with our team to discuss your stores, operations, and the KPIs we can help you improve.

Does Hi Auto support franchise and corporate operations?

Yes. Franchisees can adjust local offers while the corporate maintains brand consistency and system-wide standards.

What KPIs does Hi Auto improve for QSRs?

Hi Auto helps improve order accuracy, order completion rate, labor efficiency, average check size, and guest satisfaction across all locations.
